title: Approval verdict
description: The answer of the narrow API of a PDP to a PEP (protocol 17.4): a read of a request and a keepalive. The root schema is the answer of those two routes. It has the verdict only. The members of $defs give the answer to a submission, the body of a keepalive and an error. No answer has the text of a refusal, the owner, a device, the explanation or the time of an answer (protocol 17.12).

verdict.description: What a PEP learns about a request (protocol 17.6). A PEP treats a value that it does not know as void (protocol 17.7).

submission_answer.description: The answer to a submission: HTTP 201 for a new request, and HTTP 200 for a request that is still pending (protocol 17.4).

code.description: A short text that the owner sees. The PEP gives it to the agent.

subject.description: The subject of the request, from the identity token of the call.

error.description: The body of an error of the narrow API (protocol 17.4). The code rate_limited has retry_after.
